## 主张 Claim

在固定关系法则与实现含义下，实际前缀后的 n 步共同实现，可沿同一中间配置接成前缀长度加 n 步的共同实现。旧共同激活规律给出一步准备改变当前一步能力、解除共同条件后任何有限步均不能共同实现，以及能力未被实际使用的路径。无界可达的回溯复用已有推论，不另计成果。 / Under a fixed relational law and realization interpretation, joint realization within n steps after an actual prefix is reachable through the same intermediate configuration within prefix length plus n steps. The existing joint-activation law supplies changed one-step capacity after preparation, loss of joint realization at every finite horizon after release, and a path leaving available joint capacity unused. Unbounded backward reachability repeats the established inference and is not counted as another result.

Canonical source: [RelationalBecoming.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RelationalBecoming.lean)
